 vendor-locked:
 if: needs.changes.outputs.product_changed == 'true'
 needs: changes
 name: Vendor locked baseline
 runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 timeout-minutes: 10
 steps:

 with:

 - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
 with:
 version: "latest"
 python-version: "3.15"
 activate-environment: true
 enable-cache: true
 save-cache: true
 prune-cache: true
 - name: Resolve parent main for shared vendor tools
 id: parent-vendor-tools
 env:
 GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
 run: |
 set -euo pipefail
 python -S scripts/parent_vendor_tools_resolve.py --emit-github-actions
 - name: Fetch shared vendor tool at resolved parent main
 uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

 path: .vendor-sync-tools
 persist-credentials: false
 - name: Sync locked development environment
 shell: bash
 run: |
 uv sync --locked --python "$(python -c 'import sys; print(sys.executable)')"
 python -c "import os; from pathlib import Path; print(Path('.venv').resolve() / ('Scripts' if os.name == 'nt' else 'bin'))" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
 - name: Network parent vendor tools resolve regressions
 env:
 GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

 set -euo pipefail

 test:
 timeout-minutes: 30
 if: needs.changes.outputs.product_changed == 'true'
 needs: changes
 runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 strategy:
 fail-fast: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
 matrix:
 python: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && fromJSON('["3.14"]') || fromJSON('["3.11", "3.12", "3.14"]') }}
 steps:

 node-version: 'latest'
 - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
 with:
 version: "latest"
 python-version: "${{ matrix.python }}"
 activate-environment: true
 enable-cache: true
 save-cache: true
 prune-cache: true

 python -c "import os; from pathlib import Path; print(Path('.venv').resolve() / ('Scripts' if os.name == 'nt' else 'bin'))" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
 - run: python -S -c "import cli_args; assert cli_args.__all__"
 - run: uv run --locked pytest -q -m "not network" -ra --tb=short --junitxml=test-results/pytest-${{ matrix.python }}.xml

 - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
 with:
 node-version: 'latest'
 - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
 with:
 version: "latest"
 python-version: "3.15"
 activate-environment: true
 enable-cache: true
 save-cache: true
 prune-cache: true
 - name: Sync locked development environment
 shell: bash
 run: |
 uv sync --locked --python "$(python -c 'import sys; print(sys.executable)')"
 python -c "import os; from pathlib import Path; print(Path('.venv').resolve() / ('Scripts' if os.name == 'nt' else 'bin'))" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
 - run: python -S -c "import cli_args; assert cli_args.__all__"
 - run: uv run --locked pytest -q -m "not network" -ra --tb=short tests/test_cli_args.py tests/test_cli_args_main.py tests/test_stdlib_surfaces.py tests/test_option_suggestions.py tests/test_node_bridge.py --junitxml=test-results/core-${{ matrix.os }}.xml
 - run: node --test tests/cli_args.test.cjs
 - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
 if: always()
 with:
 name: junit-core-${{ matrix.os }}
 path: test-results/core-${{ matrix.os }}.xml
 if-no-files-found: error
 retention-days: 14


 negative-evidence:
 timeout-minutes: 30
 if: needs.changes.outputs.product_changed == 'true'
 needs: changes
 name: negative evidence / intentional failures
 runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 steps:
 - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
 - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
 with:
 version: "latest"
 python-version: "3.15"
 activate-environment: true
 enable-cache: true
 save-cache: true
 prune-cache: true
 - name: Sync locked development environment
 shell: bash
 run: |
 uv sync --locked --python "$(python -c 'import sys; print(sys.executable)')"
 python -c "import os; from pathlib import Path; print(Path('.venv').resolve() / ('Scripts' if os.name == 'nt' else 'bin'))" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
 - name: Run intentional failure lab and validate raw JUnit
 run: python tests/failure_lab/run_lab.py
 - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
 if: always()
 with:
 name: negative-evidence-raw
 path: |
 test-results/negative-evidence/intentional-failure.xml
 test-results/negative-evidence/receipt.json
 test-results/negative-evidence/child-stdout.txt
 test-results/negative-evidence/child-stderr.txt
 test-results/negative-evidence/diagnostics.log
 if-no-files-found: error
 retention-days: 14

 negative-failure-identity:
 needs: [changes, negative-evidence]
 if: (always()) && needs.changes.outputs.product_changed == 'true'
 permissions:
 contents: read
 actions: read
 uses: myon-bioinformatics/myon-bioinformatics/.github/workflows/reusable-junit-identity.yml@1368174821fb03be258ecf3312ce0ea809f6ea22
 with:
 commit-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
 expected-reports: '["negative-evidence-raw/intentional-failure.xml"]'
 artifact-pattern: "negative-evidence-raw"
 output-artifact: negative-failure-identity

 failure-identity:
 needs: [changes, test, node-runtime, docker-integration, portability]
 if: (always()) && needs.changes.outputs.product_changed == 'true'
 permissions:
 contents: read
 actions: read
 uses: myon-bioinformatics/myon-bioinformatics/.github/workflows/reusable-junit-identity.yml@1368174821fb03be258ecf3312ce0ea809f6ea22
 with:
 commit-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
 expected-reports: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '["junit-py3.14/pytest-3.14.xml","junit-node-ubuntu-latest-26/node-ubuntu-latest-26.xml","junit-core-windows/core-windows.xml","junit-core-macos/core-macos.xml"]' || '["junit-py3.11/pytest-3.11.xml","junit-py3.12/pytest-3.12.xml","junit-py3.14/pytest-3.14.xml","junit-node-ubuntu-latest-26/node-ubuntu-latest-26.xml","junit-node-ubuntu-latest-latest/node-ubuntu-latest-latest.xml","junit-node-windows-latest-26/node-windows-latest-26.xml","junit-node-windows-latest-latest/node-windows-latest-latest.xml","junit-node-macos-latest-26/node-macos-latest-26.xml","junit-node-macos-latest-latest/node-macos-latest-latest.xml","junit-docker-integration/docker-integration.xml","junit-container-real/container-real.xml","junit-core-windows/core-windows.xml","junit-core-macos/core-macos.xml"]' }}
 artifact-pattern: "junit-*"
 output-artifact: failure-identity

 actionlint:
 needs: changes
 if: needs.changes.outputs.workflow_changed == 'true'
 permissions:
 contents: read
 uses: myon-bioinformatics/myon-bioinformatics/.github/workflows/reusable-actionlint.yml@1368174821fb03be258ecf3312ce0ea809f6ea22
